title: Fixed-prime derived localization and stalk comparison glue
statement: In the affine cartesian square and for a fixed prime p of A', after introducing the local algebras and a derived tensor cohomology model n, there exists an isomorphism e from the localized affine source U to the fixed localizedComparison source such that every coefficient-compatible chain isomorphism tau satisfies the required homology comparison equation.

source.place: Tag 0DJ8, affine displayed localization identity and comparison compatibility; Tags 06Y6 and 01I9.

proof.text: Use stalkMap_toStalk and the two tensor-algebra restriction hypotheses to construct psi:Aq tensor_R Rprime to D as the tensor-product lift of the actual Aq-to-D stalk map and kappa composed with phi_fprime. Its two restrictions are proved by lift_tmul. Supply the compatible scalar towers.

Use the existing affine stalk scalar-extension coordinates chi to identify Aq tensor_A M with Q=stalkComplex(P). Choose the existing base-derived model k on Aq tensor_A M and m on Q, both over the original base R and second ring Rprime. Apply first-factor localization to n and k. Transport k to m along chi using the existing quasi-isomorphism comparison theorem; compose the D-linear source isomorphisms. Tensor associativity gives b, and the equality of the original coefficient maps gives delta. Set beta=delta inverse followed by b followed by extension of chi. Prove its numerator action from the three existing pure-tensor formulas, and compose the comparison squares to prove a followed by H(beta)=e1 followed by m.localizedComparison.

Apply the base and second-factor affine localization comparison to m, psi and beta. Its equation for each compatible tau uses H(beta inverse followed by tau). Compose the two source isomorphisms, use beta.hom followed by beta.inv followed by tau.hom equals tau.hom, apply homologyMap_comp, and combine the two comparison equations by associativity.

proof_origin.place: Affine localization identity, factored into first-factor localization and base/second-factor localization; Tag 06Y6 for derived-model comparison.

theorem affineDirectLocalizedTensorSquare_core
    (R A R' A' : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing R'] [CommRing A']
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R R'] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] R') A']
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wM} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wM} (ModuleCat.{u} R')]
    (φg' : A →+* A') (φf' : R' →+* A')
    (hφg' : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] R') A').comp
      (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] R')) = φg')
    (hφf' : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] R') A').comp
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = φf')
    (sq : IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg')) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf'))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))))
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (i : ℤ)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum A') :
    let P := ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M)
      let f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))
      let f' := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf')
      let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))
      let g' := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg')
      letI := SingleComplexBaseChange.leftAlgebra f g' p
      letI := SingleComplexBaseChange.rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq p
      letI := (SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorMap f f' g g' sq p).toAlgebra
      letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (SingleComplexBaseChange.R f g' p))
      letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (SingleComplexBaseChange.B f' p))
      let D : Type u := (Spec.structureSheaf A').presheaf.stalk p
      let κ := (StructureSheaf.toStalk A' p).hom
      letI : Algebra (A ⊗[R] R') D :=
        (κ.comp (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] R') A')).toAlgebra
      (n : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A R' M D) →
      let C := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (κ.comp φg')).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M
      let U := affineBaseChangeTildeModule R A R' D M n i
      let hφ : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] R') D).comp
          (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] R')) = κ.comp φg' :=
        by
          change (κ.comp (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] R') A')).comp _ = _
          rw [RingHom.comp_assoc, hφg'] 
      let a := affineBaseChangeTildeModuleMap R A R' D M n (κ.comp φg') hφ i
        (C.homology i) (Iso.refl _)
      let ρ := (SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorMap f f' g g' sq p).comp
        (algebraMap (SingleComplexBaseChange.A g' p)
          (SingleComplexBaseChange.A g' p ⊗[SingleComplexBaseChange.R f g' p]
            SingleComplexBaseChange.B f' p))
      let l :=
        (SingleComplexBaseChange.cohomologyModel f f' g g' sq p P).localizedComparison i
      ∃ e : U ≅ (Arrow.mk l).left,
        ∀ τ : C ≅
            SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorComplex f f' g g' sq p P,
          (∀ (j : ℤ) (x : M.X j),
            τ.hom.f j ((1 : D) ⊗ₜ[A, κ.comp φg'] x) =
              (1 : (Spec (.of A')).presheaf.stalk p) ⊗ₜ[SingleComplexBaseChange.A g' p, ρ]
                (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (P.X j).val.presheaf ⊤ (g' p) trivial
                  (tilde.toOpen (R := .of A) (M.X j) ⊤ x))) →
          a ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap τ.hom i = e.hom ≫ l
